status: postfit diagnostic preregistration; before implementation and before any audit execution
purpose: Decompose error against fixed final-network Bellman self-targets into per-curve affine deadline floor and excess; no model selection, fitting, rollout, or native environment

sampling.eligible: successor_valid == True within the exact existing whole-episode split; do not additionally select on goal, action, outcome, or successor_core_valid
sampling.implementation: numpy.default_rng(123).choice on eligible indices in their existing ascending split order; retain sampled order
sampling.insufficient_rows: fail instead of shrinking or replacing the declared panel

curves.weights: uniform weight1 on every usable positive deadline; preserve replay_batch usability masks
curves.current_already_goal_rows: preserve all native fit labels; no new current-goal mask
curves.horizon_zero: analytic Q0 boundary is excluded from all projections, means, and losses

targets.held_fixed: materialize all per-curve targets before any least-squares projection
targets.semantics: same goal at h-1; successor hit takes precedence over physical failure; missing terminal successor is unusable; collection cuts are not failures

projection.objective: weighted least squares independently for each fixed replay-row, goal, and factual action
projection.rank_one: retain any curve with one usable point, use constant mean with zero slope and report rank1; never drop a declared curve
projection.affinity_check: verify actual deployed predictions at every positive deadline against the line through h1 and h256; all curve/action predictions audited are factual-action values
projection.failure_policy: fail audit on nonfinite usable values, failed affinity check, or excessive decomposition remainder

denominators: retain64selected rows,16goals per row,all256deadlines; report usable points, missing masks,rank, and initial-current-goal counts without excluding them

provenance.requirements: verify input bytes and restored source identity; archive audit source bytes and selected row IDs/content hashes before model inference; weights and files unchanged after audit

interpretation: Postfit observational diagnostic, not prospective efficacy evidence
Affine floor is relative to frozen self-targets, not optimal first-hit values
Independent per-curve projection only lower-bounds a jointly shared network representation constraint
Excess may include shared-parameter constraints and optimization; not unique causal attribution
No change to running r3/main evaluation or projected-grid fits
